courier-window.name: courier-window
courier-window.description: Route courier arrivals at the depot to the right queue.
courier-window.instructions:
# Courier window

Route each courier arrival at the depot by what it is, its seal, its weight and its arrival hour (24-hour clock). Apply the first rule that matches, in this order:

1. A parcel goes to Loading Bay 2. An envelope over 500 g is handled as a parcel.
2. A broken seal goes to Red Desk. A resealed envelope counts as broken.
3. An envelope marked priority goes to Blue Annex at any hour.
4. An intact envelope arriving at hour 18 or later goes to Blue Annex.
5. Any other envelope goes to Green Gate.

ferry-reimbursement.name: ferry-reimbursement
ferry-reimbursement.description: Calculate the amount reimbursable on a staff travel claim.
ferry-reimbursement.instructions:
# Ferry settlement

1. Subtract any rebate from the paid amount; that is the net cost.
2. For ferry travel, reimburse the smaller of the net cost and 51 units.
3. Tram travel is limited to 18 units.
4. A claim filed more than 30 days after travel is reimbursed at half the amount from step 2 or 3, rounded down.
